titleEn: Sit on the Stone, Sit Down to Eat!

pages.text: "Time for our work-break meal!" Grandma, who had farmed rice all her life, set bowls of rice and greens beside a flat stone on the bank. Dingding took a bowl and stood up. "I'll eat while watching the ducks!" Dingding walked along the bank.
One bite, two steps. Another bite, two more steps. "Sit down to eat!" Grandma called. Dingding ignored her and watched the ducks below. Grains of rice dropped onto the bank.
The bowl tilted in Dingding's one hand. Half the rice tumbled into the paddy! Quacking ducks gathered to eat it. Dirt splashed onto the remaining rice, making it gritty. Dingding's ears drooped.

Grandma sat Dingding on the flat stone. "Shall we play a game? This is the sticky-rice-cake stone. Once you sit, your bottom sticks like a rice cake!" She tapped the stone. Dingding pressed their bottom down.
Mr. Ming, who kept ducks in the lowest paddy, came up for the meal. "A sticky-rice-cake stone? I'll stick to it, too!" He sat firmly down. Dingding sat beside him. "Stick!"
"One, sit firmly on the stone! Two, hold your bowl with both hands! Three, get up when it's empty!" Grandma sang, "Sit on the Stone, Sit Down to Eat!" Dingding held the bowl tightly.

Even when the ducks quacked, Dingding stayed firmly seated. Dingding ate and sang, "Sit on the Stone, Sit Down to Eat!" Greens and rice cakes, a bit of everything—for the first time, Dingding finished the meal without leaving their seat.

Dingding held up the empty bowl and lifted their shoulders proudly. Dingding sniffed. Sitting still, they could smell the greens, too. Mr. Ming raised both arms. "You stayed seated until your bowl was empty!"
Now Dingding knew. "One, sit firmly! Two, hold the bowl! Three, get up when it's empty!" At the next day's meal, Dingding was the first to sit on the stone. "Sit on the Stone, Sit Down to Eat!"

Grandma hugged Dingding. "Food tastes different when you sit still, doesn't it?" Sitting to eat kept the rice from going to the ducks. Dingding took a bite of greens. "Sit on the Stone, Sit Down to Eat!"
